ablation.name: phase4h1a_eota_per_subband
ablation.notes: Phase 4H.1a: End-of-trajectory AdaIN (EOTA) + per_subband. Solves 4G.2b insight: multi-step Euler (num_steps=12) applies AdaIN each step, residual (1-alpha)^12 -> 0, alpha invalidated. EOTA: apply AdaIN ONLY at last step (i==steps-1), first N-1 steps are pure spectral Euler. Restores alpha effectiveness: single-step residual (1-alpha)^1. Test with per_subband mode (4G.2 clip SOTA 0.7361) + alpha=1.0. Goal: keep clip gain while controlling lpips to <=0.3453. Theory: decouple ODE solving from style injection. If PASS + clip>0.7319: new SOTA, paper Core Story upgraded to include EOTA insight.
